title: ListEgressRulesResponse
description: Paginated list of egress rules for a cluster.

EgressRule.description: Represents an egress traffic rule controlling outbound connections from a CockroachDB cluster.

id.description: Unique identifier of the egress rule.

name.description: Human-readable name of the egress rule.

destination.description: Destination hostname or CIDR for allowed outbound traffic.

ports.description: List of destination port numbers allowed by this rule.

type.description: Type of egress rule (FQDN or CIDR).

PaginationResponse.description: Pagination metadata included in list responses.

next.description: Token or cursor for retrieving the next page of results.

last.description: Token or cursor for the last page of results.

time.description: Server time at which the paginated query was executed.
